An '''unidentified Hapan''' served as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of [[Unidentified Volgh Leader|Volgh Leader]] in [[Volgh Squadron]], which was part of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]]. Sometime in [[44 ABY]], Volgh Squadron participated in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], after the [[Jedi academy|academy]] came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. During the evacuation, Volgh Leader and her wingmate were ordered to disable the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] of the [[Hapan]] transport ''[[Sharmok 718]]'', suspected to have been captured by the Sith. Volgh Leader's shots were evaded by the transport but was eventually hit by the wingmate's lasers. Rather than be boarded, ''Sharmok 718'' detonated its stockpile of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] and self destructed, destroying all of Volgh Squadron along with it.<ref name="apocalypse" />
